talent.fortune_syn_cataclysm_vortex.desc: Unlocks the reactive synergy Cataclysm Vortex (BlackHole + VoxelTornado). Auto-activates in a run once both abilities are equipped. Black Hole + Arcane Tornado: Tornadoes passing through Black Hole (or expiring) destabilize into 6 explosive gravity shards.
talent.fortune_syn_cataclysm_vortex.name: Cataclysm Vortex
talent.fortune_syn_overcharged_grid.desc: Unlocks the reactive synergy Overcharged Grid (LaserTurret + Shooter). Auto-activates in a run once both abilities are equipped. Laser Turret + Shooter: Active turrets link via high-voltage laser fences (<=12m), while passing Shooter projectiles gain +2 pierce.
talent.fortune_syn_overcharged_grid.name: Overcharged Grid
talent.fortune_syn_phantom_legion.desc: Unlocks the reactive synergy Phantom Legion (ShadowDecoy + MiniDragon). Auto-activates in a run once both abilities are equipped. When a Shadow Decoy detonates it explodes into a ring of 8 dragon fireballs flying in every direction.
talent.fortune_syn_phantom_legion.name: Phantom Legion
talent.fortune_syn_solar_eclipse.desc: Unlocks the reactive synergy Solar Eclipse (SkyfallSpire + BlackHole). Auto-activates in a run once both abilities are equipped. 0.3s before a Skyfall Spire lands, an eclipse pulse drags enemies into the strike point; the strike deals +35% damage and blinds survivors.
talent.fortune_syn_solar_eclipse.name: Solar Eclipse
talent.fury_arsenal.name: +1 Active Slot
talent.fury_keystone.desc: KEYSTONE: +1 Active ability slot and an extra -8% cooldown on everything.
talent.fury_keystone.name: Overclocked Arsenal
talent.fury_r1a.desc: Permanently +6% critical hit chance. (Inner ring: also purchasable with coins.)
talent.fury_r1a.name: +6% Crit Chance
talent.fury_r1b.desc: Permanently +8% damage for weapon and abilities. (Inner ring: also purchasable with coins.)
talent.fury_r1b.name: +8% Damage
talent.fury_r2.desc: +10% radius / area for abilities, weapon splash and ultimates.
talent.fury_r2.name: +10% Global Area
talent.fury_r4a.name: +15% Boss Damage
talent.fury_r4b.desc: Abilities, weapon and ultimate recharge 10% faster.
talent.fury_r4b.name: +10% Cooldown Reduction
talent.fury_syn_blade_storm.desc: Unlocks the reactive synergy Blade Storm (orbital_small_sword + Boomerang). Auto-activates in a run once both abilities are equipped. Orbital Sword + Boomerang: Orbital swords launch piercing spectral blades every 2.8s and on every 3rd Boomerang hit.
talent.fury_syn_blade_storm.name: Blade Storm
talent.fury_syn_dragon_lord.desc: Unlocks the reactive synergy Dragon Lord (MiniDragon + BattleFury). Auto-activates in a run once both abilities are equipped. Dragon Whelp + Battle Fury: Dragon Whelps breathe Fury flames that pierce 3 enemies and leave burning embers underneath hit targets.
talent.fury_syn_dragon_lord.name: Dragon Lord
talent.fury_syn_ricochet_barrage.desc: Unlocks the reactive synergy Ricochet Barrage (BuzzsawChakram + CriticalLens). Auto-activates in a run once both abilities are equipped. Every critical hit of a Buzzsaw Chakram spawns a shrapnel mini-disc (2 ricochets) and speeds up the main disc.
talent.fury_syn_ricochet_barrage.name: Ricochet Barrage
talent.fury_syn_toxic_inferno.desc: Unlocks the reactive synergy Toxic Inferno (PoisonAlchemist + Fireball). Auto-activates in a run once both abilities are equipped. Poison Flask + Fireball: Fireball blasts ignite Poison Puddles into exploding napalm fields dealing 1.6x detonation and 2x burn damage.
talent.fury_syn_toxic_inferno.name: Toxic Inferno
talent.mastery_lv10.desc: Abilities can level up to Lv 10 (base cap: Lv 5) and reach their first OVERDRIVE. (Inner ring: also purchasable with coins.)
talent.mastery_lv10.name: Overdrive: Lv 10 Cap
talent.mastery_lv20.desc: Abilities can level up to Lv 20 and AWAKEN at Lv 20.
talent.mastery_lv20.name: Awakening: Lv 20 Cap
talent.mastery_lv50.desc: Abilities can level up to Lv 50: MYTHIC tiers at Lv 30 / 40 / 50 add +25% ability damage each. Requires 28 unlocked stars.
talent.mastery_lv50.name: Mythic Ascension: Lv 50 Cap
talent.origin.desc: The heart of your star map. Every constellation grows outward from here. Defeat mini-bosses (+1), bosses (+5) and clear Shrines (+2) to earn Boss Shards.
talent.origin.name: Constellation Core
